name: com.michal-chrobot.determinism-validation
description: A comprehensive determinism validation package for Unity DOTS. Supports full-game validation (comparing multiple simulation runs), system-level validation (testing individual ECS systems for determinism), and cross-platform comparison via exportable hash logs. Includes debugging tools to identify sources of nondeterminism.

samples.description: Example demonstrating how to validate individual ECS systems for determinism
Example demonstrating full-game determinism validation over multiple runs
